bullets.text: Q2 CR 87.3; Personal Lines CR 87.6 (including 4.0 cat pts); Commercial Lines CR 85.3; personal property CR 78.0 (13.5 cat pts); personal vehicles CR 88.0.
Companywide NPW +5% YOY; Personal Lines NPW +5% (+6% YTD); Commercial Lines NPW +4%; personal vehicles NPW +5%; personal property NPW +1% amid competitive post-hard-market conditions.
Total PIF +7% YOY, surpassing 40M milestone; personal auto PIF +9% (+2.2M); special lines added ~500K PIFs, boat program topping 2M; property PIF +1%.
Repurchased >$1B shares in 1H 2026; debt-to-capital remained <20% despite $1.5B senior notes; portfolio returned 1.2% (equity 15.3%, fixed income 0.6%); investment income $979M (+12%).
Achieved #1 private passenger auto ranking based on trailing 12-month NPW; commercial auto industry Q1 CR ~104 ex-Progressive highlights significant competitive edge.
Media spend grew 18% YTD through June; agent incentive spending more than doubled to fuel acquisition across core lines; personal auto conversion gained +5% YOY.
Personal auto model 9.0 deployed to 19 states (~50% auto PIF); commercial auto model 8.3 elevated to 21 states (59% NPW), with 8.4 launching Q3.
Headquarters tour and essay contest highlighted frontline claims and service representatives demonstrating core purpose; customer commendations reinforce high-touch culture driving retention.
Personal Lines vehicle NAER improved 0.2 pts YTD through June via disciplined operational efficiencies and ongoing technology enhancements across claims and underwriting.
Commercial auto competitors continuing mid-single-digit rate hikes into Q2 amid industrywide underwriting losses; Progressive moderating rate actions and targeting selective reductions in trucking.
